description: This file declares the 'Underflow' class within the 'firebolt::rialto::server::tasks::generic' namespace. The class represents a task related to handling buffer underflow events in a media player context, including methods for execution and internal state management. It includes dependencies on various interfaces and context classes relevant to a media playback system.

classes.name: Underflow
classes.description: Represents a task to handle buffer underflow events in the media player, managing context, player, client, and source type information.

methods.name: Underflow
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Underflow task with context, player, client, underflow flag, enabled state, and source type.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the underflow handling logic for the media player task.

methods.name: allSourcesEos
methods.description: Checks if all media sources have reached end-of-stream.
